propositions: CPython HTTPServer.server_bind invokes socket.getfqdn on numeric loopback addresses, causing 35-second reverse DNS delays on macOS CI runners despite the test contract requiring no reverse resolution
ThreadingHTTPServer constructor for editor loopback fixture triggers getfqdn unnecessarily because callers consume only literal bound address/port, not reverse-resolved server_name

A custom _LoopbackThreadingHTTPServer subclass delegates bind to TCPServer.server_bind and derives server_name from already-bound literal address, eliminating reverse DNS without adding dependencies or weakening test coverage

The fix preserves all contractual editor workflow behavior: real TCP loopback bind, ephemeral port, request handling, token/session, and shutdown remain unchanged; only unused server_name value changes from reverse-resolved to literal
